title: Filters
summary: Smooth footage treatments for a clean magazine film, shown on the sample clip under the theme grade: a grade measured on bright daylight footage (cool paper whites held under clipping, aubergine shadows, rich reds and skin), a darker moody grade that can wipe itself on behind a paper hairline, a slow push, a glide that lands a cut with motion blur, a focus pull, a speed-ramp swell, one band of warm light and a soft crimson-and-blue siren glow, rotating red and blue siren beams, a clean low-key magazine-cover grade in three tones, plus paper grain, a soft vignette and a few quiet shared treatments. Nothing strobes, flashes, splits or shakes.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "editorial_grade", "amount": 0.7}}} and, in "effects": {"name": "glide_blur", "at": 5.57, "seconds": 0.3, "where": "in", "amount": 1, "props": {"dir": "left"}} on a cut, {"name": "moody_grade", "at": 9.2, "seconds": 2.4, "where": "all", "amount": 1, "props": {"wipe": true}} over a line, {"name": "siren_glow", "at": 14, "seconds": 1.6, "where": "all", "amount": 0.9}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "focus_pull", "amount": 1, "where": "in", "seconds": 0.4}}. soft_push, light_sweep, siren_glow and moody_grade with wipe time themselves over their seconds ("where": "all"). Own effects: library/themes/editorial/effects/theme_effects.py; halation, bloom and focus come from library/_shared/effects_engine.py.

items.name: editorial grade
items.description: The theme look for bright daylight footage (footage.look, about 0.7): a gentle S-curve, whites rolled off just under clipping and left cool like paper, shadows nudged toward aubergine, reds and skin kept rich, fine grain, a very light vignette. Subtle: the footage still looks like itself. Options ("props"): contrast (1), grain (1), vignette (1).

items.name: moody grade
items.description: A clearly darker, low-key look: lower exposure, deep aubergine shadows, wine in the mid-tones, heavy soft corners, a little warm halation off the highlights. Hold it over a line ("where": "all", 1.5 s or more). Options: wipe (false). With wipe true the grade is drawn on by a soft vertical edge with a paper hairline sweeping left to right over the first 35% of the effect and taken off the same way over the last 20% (wipe_in, wipe_out), as in the preview.

items.name: moody cover
items.description: A clean low-key magazine-cover grade: the surroundings drop (white walls to a soft mid grey, darker toward the edges, a large soft vignette centred on the face) and lose most of their colour, while skin keeps its hue and most of its light and the jacket's reds stay red and a little richer; blacks are deep but keep their detail, the shadows carry a faint tint, with fine grain and a breath of halation. It eases itself in with no wipe line: "where": "all", 0.7 s or more, amount 1. Options ("props"): tone (cool: aubergine/blue-black shadows and cool grey walls | warm: brown-umber | neutral; cool), face ([.5, .42]: put it on the speaker's face), fade (.3: share of the time it takes to arrive), fade_out (0), depth (1: how far the room drops), grain (1).

items.name: soft push
items.description: The slow push: the picture scales up to about 1.06 over the effect's time, eased at both ends, toward the face; no blur. "where": "all", 1.5-4 s, ending on a cut. Options: face ([.5, .42]), reverse (true pulls out).

items.name: glide blur
items.description: Lands a cut smoothly: the picture arrives still travelling a few percent of the frame with a directional motion blur that is strongest on the first frame and eases out to nothing. "where": "in", 0.25-0.4 s ("out" leaves the same way). Options: dir (left|right|up|down, the way the picture travels; left), travel (1).

items.name: focus pull
items.description: A focus pull with a slight lens breath: "where": "in" starts soft and comes sharp (0.3-0.5 s after a cut), "out" goes soft before one. Options: strength (1), face.

items.name: speed ramp
items.description: The feel of a speed ramp: a brief radial zoom-blur that swells and settles with a small push toward the face, no bounce. "where": "pulse" on a stressed word (0.3-0.5 s) or "in" to land a cut (0.25 s). Options: face.

items.name: light sweep
items.description: One soft diagonal band of warm light crosses the picture once over the effect's time while the room dims a touch; it starts and ends off-frame and never clips to white. "where": "all", 0.8-1.5 s, amount 0.6-0.9. Options: angle (degrees, 20), width (1).

items.name: siren glow
items.description: Sirens outside, the quiet way: soft crimson light from the top-left corner and deep blue from the top-right swell in turn, sinusoidally, about two cycles a second, and it fades itself in and out over 0.3 s. No strobe. "where": "all", 1-3 s, amount 0.7-1. Options: rate (cycles per second, 2), reach (1).

items.name: siren beams
items.description: Emergency lights sweeping the room: two rotating beacons just above the top corners, emergency red on the left and deep blue on the right, each throwing a soft-edged beam that turns like a lighthouse, in counter-phase so red and blue cross the picture in turn. Coloured light (walls and faces take the colour, nothing clips), a soft bloom at each beacon, the room dimmed a little; motion-blurred and faded in and out over 15% of its time, so it sweeps rather than strobes. "where": "all", 0.8-3 s, amount 0.85-1. Options ("props"): rate (turns per second, 2), dim (.15), spread (beam width, 1), phase (turns, 0; .5 starts on blue).

items.name: paper grain
items.description: Fine monochrome grain, strongest in the mid-tones, over a faint still paper tooth. Hold it ("where": "all"), amount 0.5-1.

items.name: vignette soft
items.description: Corners fall off gently toward aubergine: no hard ring, no blur. Hold it ("where": "all"), amount 0.5-1.

items.name: halation
items.description: Shared: a soft glow off the brightest areas. Keep it low (0.3-0.5) on this bright footage.

items.name: bloom
items.description: Shared: highlights bloom softly. "where": "pulse" on a bright moment, amount 0.3-0.5.

items.name: focus
items.description: Shared: the outer part of the frame falls out of focus while the middle stays sharp, holding the eye on the face. Hold it ("where": "all") or bring it in with "out".

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
